description: One relay of the fleet over time: health, traffic, consensus, flags, load, accounting and keys. Pick the host and relay at the top, or click a nickname on the overview.

panels.description: Whether the relay's tor systemd unit is active, from the last SSH probe.
panels.title: Service

panels.description: Whether something listens on the ORPort, per address family.
panels.title: ORPort

panels.description: Whether tor's self-test confirmed the ORPort is reachable from outside, per address family.
panels.title: Reachable

panels.description: Whether Tor Metrics lists the relay, and whether the directory authorities consider it running.

targets.expr: max without (instance, job) ((tor_relay_fleet_relay_published{host="$host", nickname="$relay"} == 0) or (tor_relay_fleet_relay_running{host="$host", nickname="$relay"} + 1))

panels.title: Consensus

panels.description: The relay's role (from its flags) and tor version.
panels.title: Role, version

panels.description: Country and autonomous system of the relay's address, from Tor Metrics.
panels.title: Location

panels.description: Consensus flags the relay holds now.
panels.title: Flags

panels.description: Time since tor last restarted, as reported in the relay's descriptor (Tor Metrics). Guard and Stable need long uptimes.
panels.title: Uptime

panels.description: When Tor Metrics first saw this relay.
panels.title: First seen

panels.description: Time until the ed25519 signing certificate expires. With an offline master key renew it with tor-relay-setup keys renew before it runs out.
panels.title: Cert expiry

panels.description: Problems the relay's status report lists; run tor-relay-setup status on the host for the text.
panels.title: Warnings

panels.description: The relay's consensus weight: the bandwidth the directory authorities measured, scaled.
panels.title: Weight

panels.description: The relay's share of the network's total consensus weight.
panels.title: Net share

panels.description: Probability that a client picks this relay as its guard.
panels.title: Guard prob.

panels.description: Probability that a circuit uses this relay in the middle.
panels.title: Middle prob.

panels.description: Probability that a circuit exits through this relay.
panels.title: Exit prob.

panels.description: Bytes per second read (in) and written (out) over the last 5 minutes. Per-relay traffic and connection series are left out when fleet serve runs with privacy = true; the fleet totals stay.
panels.title: Live rate

panels.description: Bytes per second read (below the axis) and written (above). Per-relay traffic and connection series are left out when fleet serve runs with privacy = true; the fleet totals stay.

defaults.noValue: No data yet, or hidden by privacy mode

panels.title: Throughput

panels.description: Advertised and observed bandwidth from the relay's descriptor (Tor Metrics, hourly) next to what it writes.
panels.title: Bandwidth: advertised, observed, used

panels.description: Bytes read and written per day. Per-relay traffic and connection series are left out when fleet serve runs with privacy = true; the fleet totals stay.

defaults.noValue: Daily totals appear after the first full day, unless privacy mode hides them

panels.title: Traffic per day

panels.description: Open connections to other relays and clients. Per-relay traffic and connection series are left out when fleet serve runs with privacy = true; the fleet totals stay.

defaults.noValue: No data yet, or hidden by privacy mode

panels.title: OR connections

panels.description: Consensus weight (left axis) and its share of the network (right axis), from Tor Metrics.
panels.title: Consensus weight over time

panels.description: How likely clients are to pick this relay as guard, middle or exit.
panels.title: Path selection probability

panels.description: Which consensus flags the relay held, hour by hour (Tor Metrics). Gaps mean the flag was not held.
panels.title: Flags over time

panels.description: Service, ORPort, reachability, consensus and family state from every probe. Red is a problem; for "overloaded" red means yes.
panels.title: Health over time

panels.description: Number of problems the relay's status report lists.
panels.title: Status warnings

panels.description: Open sockets and tor's socket limit. At the limit tor publishes overload-fd-exhausted.
panels.title: Sockets

panels.description: Circuit handshakes processed per second, by type (ntor_v3 is current, ntor older clients, fast and tap legacy).

targets.expr: max without (instance, job) (sum by (type) (rate(tor_relay_fleet_relay_onionskins_total{host="$host", nickname="$relay", action="processed"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Onionskins processed

panels.description: Circuit handshakes dropped per second because tor's CPU workers were busy, by type.

targets.expr: max without (instance, job) (sum by (type) (rate(tor_relay_fleet_relay_onionskins_total{host="$host", nickname="$relay", action="dropped"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Onionskins dropped

panels.description: Share of ntor/ntor_v3 handshakes dropped. From 1% over 6 hours tor reports overload-general (dashed line).

targets.expr: max without (instance, job) (sum(rate(tor_relay_fleet_relay_onionskins_total{host="$host", nickname="$relay", type=~"ntor|ntor_v3", action="dropped"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum(rate(tor_relay_fleet_relay_onionskins_total{host="$host", nickname="$relay", type=~"ntor|ntor_v3"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: ntor handshake drop ratio

panels.description: Bytes tor's out-of-memory handler freed per hour, by subsystem (cell, dns, geoip, hsdir). Shown as a rate per hour.
panels.title: Freed by the OOM handler per hour

panels.description: Connections per hour that failed for lack of a local TCP port. Shown as a rate per hour.
panels.title: TCP port exhaustion per hour

panels.description: How often per hour the global BandwidthRate bucket ran empty, by side. Shown as a rate per hour.
panels.title: Global rate limit reached per hour

panels.description: When tor last reported overload-general, from Tor Metrics. Relay Search shows the relay as overloaded for 72 hours after it.
panels.title: Last overload

panels.description: Bytes counted against AccountingMax this period, the projection for its end at the current pace, and the limit.
panels.title: Accounting budget

panels.description: Share of AccountingMax used this period; tor hibernates at 100%.
panels.title: Budget used

panels.description: Time until the accounting period ends and the budget resets.
panels.title: Period ends in

panels.description: Number of FamilyIds in the relay's torrc.
panels.title: FamilyIds

panels.description: FamilyIds without their secret key on the relay.
panels.title: Missing keys

panels.description: Whether the relay's FamilyId set matches the fleet majority.
panels.title: Family

panels.description: Bridges only: whether the pluggable transport listens.
panels.title: Transport

panels.description: Time left until the ed25519 signing certificate expires. tor renews it itself unless the master key is offline; the drops are renewals.
panels.title: Signing certificate validity
